cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm keeping the picnic arrangements tidy. Lovely blue ink on the change to Friday. Is that your pen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, a shared system. And the little hearts beside Friday - are those how you mark a day you prefer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right, I moved it. Friday suits me better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Friday it is; I can work with that. Just checking the guest list now: who changed the invitations from Saturday as well? We can sort them together if nobody has.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 confidently manages arrangements through innocent pen questions; A3 accepts shared use and A5 adopts B preferred Friday while gently seeking the next alteration admission.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers an alternative explanation and B4 gives an actual preference; A avoids punishment and offers joint repair.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns the first admission into another apparently tidy information check without losing cooperative tone.

specificity.evidence: A1 picnic change and B4 Friday preference establish a legible scheduling interaction.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 if-nobody-has clause is explanatory but prevents assuming the invitations were changed.
